historical_record.description: The 54-by-109-foot site between Kearny and Montgomery held the old Armed Forces Police Station, declared surplus by the Federal government; hotels stood on the adjoining properties. The City Planning Commission unanimously reported that city acquisition of the former military police station for a Health Department methadone clinic conformed to the Master Plan.

The Department of Health, Education and Welfare handed title of the abandoned Armed Forces police station here to the San Francisco Unified School District, to house the Chinese Education Center for newly arrived immigrant pupils from September 1975. The two-storey building of more than 10,000 square feet was to be renovated for $250,000 under the Field Act, its jail cells torn out and a playground put on a new roof.

The Chinese Education Center, the school district's reception school for newly arrived immigrant children of Chinatown and North Beach, was here, next to the Holiday Inn, when it marked its tenth anniversary.
